access_evidence: probe cordis_search_results: HTTP 200 JSON at /api/search/results with payload.total and payload.results[] including rcn, reference (grant agreement id), acronym and programme; probe cordis_search_published_contract_absent: HTTP 404 SPA HTML at /api/v1/projects; probe cordis_no_publication_index: HTTP 500 index_not_found_exception. 4 domain queries -> 60 project records.
blockers: No publication index: contenttype='publication' -> HTTP 500 '[es/search] failed: [index_not_found_exception] no such index [publication]'. EU grant -> publication linkage therefore cannot be built from CORDIS.

The query parser rejects numeric-only tokens: q=685648 -> HTTP 500 'Error processing the request :Unknown filter type'; q=contenttype='project' AND 685648 -> HTTP 500 'Query is not valid'. The quoted form q="685648" works (HTTP 200) and is what the connector uses.
Field queries such as title:'medical device' -> HTTP 500 'Query is not valid', and an rcn: filter -> HTTP 500. The query language is effectively free text plus contenttype.
historical_depth: Dates arrive as human strings with unfilled template tokens such as '1 {{month_08}} 2014', so no ISO date can be read off them.
licence_note: The Commission legal notice permits reuse of Commission documents with attribution, but /api/search/results is UNDOCUMENTED: no API contract and no stated machine-interface licence. Recorded as open_no_explicit_licence, not open_licence.
machine_interface: Undocumented JSON search endpoint /api/search/results?q=&num=; no published API contract, no OpenAPI document
name: CORDIS (EU research projects)
notes: Because the endpoint is undocumented, every response is saved verbatim so the behaviour can be re-checked even if the route changes without notice.
rate_policy: Undocumented. Used at 1 req/s with num<=25.
robots_summary: Only the JSON API path is touched, never the HTML site.
unlock_route: Use the quoted numeric form for grant-agreement lookup. For a supported contract, the Commission's open-data route is the CORDIS datasets published through the EU Open Data Portal (data.europa.eu); that is a bulk download, not this API, and was not used here.
what_is_new: Supplies EU project identity (RCN + grant agreement id) and confirmed 1 of 2 declared EU grant numbers for a publication. It does NOT supply publications, so the reverse direction is impossible.
